name: KS Smart Technologies Limited
about: KS Smart Technologies Limited provides digital transformation services and advanced technology solutions in India. It offers machine learning, artificial intelligence, virtual and augmented reality, industry 4.0, web and mobile application development, marketing solutions, enterprise solutions, and smart city initiatives. It serves public safety, defence, education, transport, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. The company was formerly known as Soma Papers & Industries Limited and changed its name to KS Smart Technologies Limited in February 2026. KS Smart Technologies Limited was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Chennai, India.
